full_judgment: Let a Rule Nisi be issued calling upon the respondents to as to why the provisions of sections 13 and 14 of the অর্পিত সম্পত্তি প্রত্যর্পণ আইন, ২০০১ (Act XVI of 2001) as amended till date should not be declared to be void and as to why inclusion of the petitioner's land measuring 0.1350 acres in plot No. 3364 of SA Khatian No. 1290 (corresponding to RS Khatian No. 10342 as evident from Annexure-A to the writ petition) under Mouza Bainakhamar, Police Station and District Khulna in the Ka Schedule of vested property published in Bangladesh Gazette Extra ordinary dated 2-5-2012 at page 34942 against serial No. 8 should not be declared to have been done without lawful authority and of no legal effect and/or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper.
